$comment: openjev-demo control plane. policy.allow is 'local/*' only -- deliberately, not the
frontier-admitting '*' cache-aware-routing uses -- because this use case's whole point is
a fast, cheap, local decision layer; a turn that fell over to the frontier model would be
answering the wrong question about what this demo is for. The turn key's SECRET is never in
this file -- only sha256(secret). Run mint_keys.py to fill in the key_sha256 fields.
credentials.providers.nvidia is still required (the catalog's one frontier entry needs some
provider defined so the boot's provider cross-check passes), but INFERENCE_API_KEY may be any
non-empty placeholder -- see catalog.json's $comment. No second user is configured: this use
case doesn't have a cache-aware-routing-style Tax B claim to demonstrate (see GAPS.md).
